one_line: A silent hands-only tabletop clip: one find, one reveal, a price and a useful question, all as large text.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 two hands turn a blue D Lux wipes pack on a white table, a pink pack and a plant behind. No speech. Text: 'אם אנחנו כבר בהמלצות על מוצרים שחשוב שיהיו בתיק'; 0:03 'מצאתי מארז מגבונים אישי ועפתייייי'.
q1_hook.why: The product is in hands and moving from frame one, with a headline that names a parent's need, things for the bag (H1, S1, S4, T3). 'מצאתי' at 0:03 promises a find. It is silent, so the hook works only as text, and a muted viewer is not hurt (H6, H4).

beats.what: Hands turn a large blue pack; 'אם אנחנו כבר בהמלצות על מוצרים שחשוב שיהיו בתיק'
beats.why: A need named over the product in motion.

beats.what: She tears open the large pack; 'מצאתי מארז מגבונים אישי ועפתייייי'
She holds the small 8pcs pack; 'יש 8 מארזים קטנים בחבילה ובכל מארז יש 8 מגבונים'
beats.why: The find: a small bag-sized pack.

beats.what: She turns the small pack, pulls a wipe out; 'וזה עלה משהו כמו 6.90 לכל החבילה!'
beats.why: The price lands while the wipe is shown.

beats.what: She unfolds the wipe; 'בינתיים ראיתי את זה ב-Boom ובאורבניקה', 'תכתבו בתגובות'
beats.why: A real question to answer: where else?

beats.what: She holds the small pack to the lens; 'מתוק מתוק, לא תופס מקום וסופר מומלץ! ובואו לעקוב'
beats.why: A verdict and a follow ask.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen at 0:10 to 0:13: 'אם נתקלתן בעוד מקומות - תכתבו בתגובות'. A follow ask at 0:14. A back-to-school tip in the caption. A tip a parent might save or send.
q2_flow.why: A small find opened one step at a time, every 2 to 3 s, with the price at 0:08 and the answer to 'where' at 0:10 (R3, H5). At 17 s it fits the story (R2, R1). A pocket-size, low-price item is one to send to another parent (R5), and the question has a real purpose (R6).

q3_cta.what: On screen, 0:10 to 0:13: 'אם נתקלתן בעוד מקומות - תכתבו בתגובות'. 0:14: 'ובואו לעקוב לעוד מלא דברים שווים'. Caption: the same comment ask ('שיהיה קל למצוא'), a school-bag tip and a follow ask.
q3_cta.why: The comment ask has a stated purpose, helping others find it, so it is not bait (C2, R6). It is on screen after the value and repeated in the caption (C6). Comment and follow are two asks (C1). The text sits clear of the bottom band (F2).

q4_shown.what: A large blue D Lux 64pcs pack and a pink pack from 0:00; the large pack torn open 0:03; the small 8pcs pack 0:05; a wipe pulled out and unfolded 0:09 to 0:13; the small pack held up 0:14. Price as text only.
q4_shown.why: The product is handled from 0:00 and the tear-open shows the format (S1, S4). The price is stated but vague, 'something like 6.90 for the whole pack', with no delivery or store price shown (S3). Unfolding a wipe shows its size and thickness, which is the proof a parent needs (F4).

q5_edit.what: One continuous take of about 17 s, no cuts. Text changes about every 3 s, white with a shadow, 2 to 3 lines in the upper third. No voice or music audible in the transcript. Ends on the pack held up.
q5_edit.why: A single take with a new action and a new text every 3 s keeps it moving without cuts (R3, E2). The transcript shows no sound, so it relies on text (E4, T1). It ends with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A small personal-size wipes pack found inside a big pack, for the bag and the school bag. Serves parents packing for school.
q6_topic.why: A cheap, practical, bag-sized find tied to the start of school is useful and easy to save (K4, K7). It is quick and light with a warm 'ועפתייייי' tone (K6, K1). The caption's 'not sponsored' adds trust (S6).

q7_filmed.what: Phone on a tripod or propped, static, medium, eye level, tabletop. A white table, a plant and a pegboard behind. Bright even light, pink manicured hands only, no face, no child.
q7_filmed.why: A hands-only tabletop in bright, even light is a first-choice format and fills the frame with the product (S4, F5, F4). It looks clean and homemade (F7, H8).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold sans-serif with a shadow, 2 to 3 lines, at about 30 to 40% of the frame height, a new line about every 3 s: 'אם אנחנו כבר בהמלצות על מוצרים שחשוב שיהיו בתיק שלנו ושל הילדים' (0:00), 'מצאתי מארז מגבונים אישי ועפתייייי' (0:03), 'יש 8 מארזים קטנים בחבילה...' (0:06), 'וזה עלה משהו כמו 6.90 לכל החבילה!' (0:08), 'מתוק מתוק, לא תופס מקום וסופר מומלץ!' (0:14).
q8_text.caption: 'המלצה חמה לחפש בחנויות! מגבונים אישיים סופר חמודים!' then 'לא ממומן ולא כלום, נטו המלצה'. About 70 words: store names, the price, the comment ask, a back-to-school tip, a follow ask, 3 hashtags (#מאמאשפשוט, #הורות, #טיפים).
q8_text.why: A big, short card every 3 s reads fast and carries the whole message muted (T1, T2, T5), and sits above the bottom 35% and clear of the face-free product (T4, F2). The caption names the product and the occasion, with three generic hashtags (T7), and says plainly that it is not sponsored (T8, S7).

weak_points: A vague price with no delivery or store price; no voice or music evident; a comment ask and a follow ask together; generic hashtags.
lumebook_takeaway: A silent tabletop: the parcel torn open, the book lifted out, a page turned to the child's name, a big text card every 3 s. No face, no child.
not_verified: Whether any music plays (the machine 'תודה רבה' only shows no speech). The exact price (the creator says 'something like'). Whether the hands are the creator's. The 540 x 960 size is the saved copy, not necessarily the posted file. Correction: the small pack appears at about 0:05, on the right hand.
